description:
Compare candidate equivalent events on Polymarket vs Kalshi side by side.
    Returns displayed probabilities and their spread as a research signal. These are
    not executable quotes or arbitrage claims: verify order-book depth, fees, fills,
    and resolution rules before deciding where a contract is actually cheaper.
    Optional `query` filters by keywords in the market question. Displayed probabilities only; for executable all-in prices use list_executable_opportunities or compare_executable_quotes.
